Identity call: this is a farm / ALR-land topic page for South Surrey in the City of Surrey, not a single neighbourhood page.

The only settled South Surrey locator run is the Sunnyside Park sample (1785 148 St → H.T. Thrift Elementary / Semiahmoo Secondary, single-address basis) — it is not a farm-address run and is not transferred to any farm parcel.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect acreage buyers

items.t: Secondary suites (Surrey): only one suite per dwelling unit, at most 40% of the principal unit's habitable floor area, never a separate strata lot. A "90 m²" cap is not the current Surrey suite rule — do not use the 90 m² figure for a Surrey secondary suite. On ALR land the ALC suite rule (suite only within the principal residence) also applies — both frames must be met.

faq.q: Where is South Surrey farm land?
faq.a: Mostly on the east side around Hazelmere near 16 Avenue and 184 Street and along the Little Campbell River, and in the Serpentine and Nicomekl lowlands toward Mud Bay.

faq.q: What is the ALR and does it apply to farms in South Surrey?
faq.a: The Agricultural Land Reserve is farmland protected by the provincial Agricultural Land Commission. Farm use is generally allowed on ALR land, but subdividing, adding homes or using the land for non-farm purposes usually needs approval, so check a property's ALR status before you offer.

faq.q: What should I check before buying a farm in South Surrey?
faq.a: Check the ALR status, water source and licences, drainage and flood history, the buildings and any quota or production licences that do or do not transfer with the land. Poultry and egg production in BC are supply-managed, so a sale of the farm does not automatically include quota.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in South Surrey?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
